0xdee03 execve("/bin/sh", [ebp-0x30], [ebp-0x2c])
constraints:
  address ebp-0x20 is writable
  ebx is the GOT address of libc
  [[ebp-0x30]] == NULL || [ebp-0x30] == NULL || [ebp-0x30] is a valid argv
  [[ebp-0x2c]] == NULL || [ebp-0x2c] == NULL || [ebp-0x2c] is a valid envp

0x172841 execl("/bin/sh", eax)
constraints:
  esi is the GOT address of libc
  eax == NULL

0x172842 execl("/bin/sh", [esp])
constraints:
  esi is the GOT address of libc
  [esp] == NULL
